[script] 18.0-19.5s (people beat, the payoff; check D): 20,000 is again a floating black 'PEOPLE 20,000' headline card pasted over the stacked rooms, covering the stable room and the shaft. The line 'Room for up to 20,000 people, with their animals' shows three tiny people in one small room and no crowd or animals. Put the figure on a thing in the place (a carved tally on a wall, a sign at the entrance, a counter on the shaft head) and fill the pulled-back city with people and livestock moving through every floor.

[script] 10.5-13.5s (well beat; check D/11): no place is built for this line. Most of the frame is flat strata with a blue aquifer band, a plain pipe hanging into it and nobody doing anything for the whole beat. The shaft doesn't visibly pass any floor, carry air, or bring water up to people, and the WELL 55 M sign only appears at 13.5s. Show the shaft cutting past the carved floors, with a bucket or rope being hauled up by a person and air or water moving along it, and land the 55 M sign on the shaft or well head as the figure is spoken.
